name: Matias Asbrink
original_name: マティアス＝オースブリンク
source:
Ever since Matias successfully protected his country, he's been known as the hero.  He seems like a stubborn perfectionist, but when you find out his desperate wish...

"Even royalty are mere humans.  Only the law is absolute."

[From in-game profile]
